# OS package dependencies for lkp-deps.sh
# =========================================
#
# Packages are grouped by package manager family:
#
#   [apt]     - Ubuntu/Velinux.
#   [yum]     - CentOS/Euler/Anolis/CloudOS/Rocky/Oracle/Redhat (also
#               matches dnf).
#   pkg-name  - one real package name per line, exactly as the package
#               manager expects it. No translation/lookup happens: what
#               you write here is what gets installed.
#
# lkp-deps.sh only reads the block matching whatever package manager it
# detects on the system.
#
# Lines starting with # are comments, blank lines are ignored.
#
# To add a dependency: find the right [family] block below and add a line
# with the real package name. If the same logical dependency needs a
# different name on apt vs. yum, add it under both.
#
# Note: "perf" is intentionally NOT listed here. Its package name is
# kernel-version-specific on Ubuntu/Debian (linux-tools-$(uname -r)), so it
# is installed by the dedicated install_perf() function in lkp-deps.sh
# instead of from this file.
